goal: Explain how approved PSDC content can be published without rebuilding or redeploying the UI.

deck_context.source_summary: The deployed React browser fetches a validated manifest and Markdown directly from a public GitHub content repository whose dev, qa, stage, and prod branches mirror application tiers.
deck_context.core_claim: Reviewed content changes become visible at runtime without a UI rebuild while strict validation and fallback behavior preserve safety and availability.

sample_generation_method.input_context_preparation: No source images were required; the architecture visual was generated from the approved outline and style brief.
sample_generation_method.handoff_rule: Subagents must use the same built-in image tool in generate mode and return a blocker if unavailable.

style.name: NCI clean professional
style.visual_direction: Clean modern professional technical presentation inspired by the PSDC interface, with a clear evidence-driven architecture layout and generous whitespace.
style.color_palette: Warm white and pale blue-gray backgrounds, deep navy, restrained medium blue, teal highlights, light gray borders, and pale amber only for fallback risk.
style.typography: Large authoritative sans-serif title, compact readable labels, strong left-aligned hierarchy.
style.texture_and_finish: Crisp flat vector diagram with restrained icons and no decorative clutter.

approved_style_reference.fidelity: match style only; do not copy layout or content

slides.title: Publish Content Without Rebuilding the UI
slides.intent: Summarize the operating model, security boundary, and principal benefit in one glance.
key_points: Direct browser fetch from a public GitHub content repository
Controlled PR promotion from dev to qa to stage to prod
Validated manifest and safe Markdown rendering
Navigation, focus, refresh, and polling discover approved changes

layout.composition: Upper branch-promotion lane, central left-to-right runtime architecture, three compact operational callouts, and a bottom takeaway band.
layout.content_zones: Title at top; promotion flow below; repository, browser validation, and content outputs in the center; refresh, security, and fallback callouts at bottom.

visual_elements.main_visual: Flat vector architecture showing GitHub content repository to deployed React UI to validated pages.
visual_elements.supporting_elements: Branch cards, PR arrows, shield, refresh, lock, and fallback icons.

constraints: All slide text must remain exact and readable.
No watermark, unrelated logo, stock photo, or page number.
